subject.title: Exec/tool failures show "(see attached image)" and suppress model response

question: Should a zero-payload turn with lastToolError surface an incomplete-turn fallback or compact exec warning when no user-facing reply was delivered, or should lastToolError continue suppressing those paths by default?
rationale: Current source shows the exact warning and fallback gates, but changing them affects cross-channel noise, replay safety, and terminal failure semantics; the durable behavior contract needs maintainer intent before automation edits it.

options.title: Keep open for policy decision
options.body: Use this issue to define the no-reply/tool-error contract before any repair changes payloads.ts or incomplete-turn.ts.

options.title: Fold into placeholder canonical
options.body: Close this as covered by the broader placeholder cluster and explicitly leave exec warning and incomplete-turn fallback behavior unchanged.

options.title: Queue a narrow repair after live proof
options.body: After current-main live reproduction, change only the zero-payload/no-user-reply branches and add focused regression tests.

recommendation.title: Keep open for policy decision
recommendation.body: Use this issue to define the no-reply/tool-error contract before any repair changes payloads.ts or incomplete-turn.ts.
